title: Relaxed measurement criterion for low mobility

entities.name: Relaxed measurement criterion for low mobility
entities.description: A measurement criterion that applies when the UE has low mobility, allowing relaxed measurement requirements.

entities.name: Current SS-RSRP
entities.description: The current L3 RSRP measurement of the SpCell based on SSB, measured in dB.

entities.name: Reference SS-RSRP
entities.description: The reference L3 RSRP measurement of the SpCell based on SSB, set by the UE under specific conditions.

entities.name: Timer SearchDeltaP-Connected
entities.description: A timer used to determine when the relaxed measurement criterion has not been met.

entities.name: UE action to set reference SS-RSRP
entities.description: The UE sets the reference SS-RSRP to the current SS-RSRP value of the SpCell when the relaxed measurement criterion has not been met for Timer SearchDeltaP-Connected.

relations.description: The relaxed measurement criterion is evaluated based on whether it has not been met for Timer SearchDeltaP-Connected.
The UE action sets the reference SS-RSRP value.
The UE action uses the current SS-RSRP value to set the reference SS-RSRP.
The condition that the relaxed measurement criterion has not been met for Timer SearchDeltaP-Connected triggers the UE action to set the reference SS-RSRP.
